_about: "Ib."/"ib." restored as the book prints it. Sefaria's 2018 text has the book's "Ib." here; its current text names the work instead (Gen. R., Kel. in "Tosef. ib. B. Kam.", Midr. Till. …). These are those places, with Sefaria's name and link, kept so that they can be used again later if wanted (the user, 7 Nov 2026). make_site2.py restores "Ib." in each (IB_NAMED): "occ" counts the matches of "<sefaria> <next>" in the entry before this one. "manual": places where Sefaria changed more than the "Ib." (e.g. "Ex. ib. 35" -> "Ex. XXI, 35"), restored by text_fixes records instead.
